learning_order:
**Solo default: Arms (2H) or Fury (DW); Protection is viable but slow per Warcraft Tavern Forever.**

- **1-10:** Battle Shout, Charge, Rend, Parry, Thunder Clap, Hamstring, Heroic Strike. Do the Defensive Stance quest at 10 (grants Sunder Armor, Taunt).
- **10-14:** Bloodrage, Rend 2, Battle Shout 2, Overpower, Shield Bash. Tactical Mastery at 14 (baseline in Forever).
- **14-20:** Demoralizing Shout and Revenge are optional (tank/Prot). Skip Mocking Blow. Shield Block only with a shield. Disarm is optional.
- **20:** Victory Rush and Retaliation are key. Rend 3 yes. Dual Wield only for Fury, Slam only with Improved Slam, Cleave rank 1 for groups.
- **22-28:** Battle Shout 3, Sunder Armor 2, Execute (24), Heroic Strike 4, Charge 2. Intimidating Shout optional. Skip Challenging Shout solo.
- **30:** Berserker Stance quest. Rend 4, Overpower 2 (Arms). Berserker Rage optional.
- **32-40:** Battle Shout, Heroic Strike, Execute ranks. Skip Hamstring 2 and Shield Bash 2. Whirlwind at 36. Pummel at 38 (your shield-free interrupt). Plate Mail at 40.
- **40-60:** keep Battle Shout, Heroic Strike, Execute, Rend, Sunder and Charge current. Talent ranks (Mortal Strike, Bloodthirst, Shield Slam at 48/54/60) are very cheap; buy them if talented.
- Thunder Clap, Cleave, Overpower (non-Arms) and Demoralizing Shout ranks: buy only if you use them a lot.

**Money tips**
- Weapon upgrades matter most: warriors get 95-100% of damage from the weapon (Method.gg).
- Safe skips: Mocking Blow, Challenging Shout, Hamstring ranks 2-3, Shield Bash ranks 2-3, Pummel rank 2.
- Recklessness (50) is a nice burst but not needed to level.
- Save for riding at 40; Skinning or Mining are easy early income (Method.gg).
- Tank in dungeons? Then Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout, Revenge, Shield Block, Shield Wall become core buys.
disagreements: Whirlwind: Warcraft Tavern Forever calls it strong for leveling in any spec vs several mobs; Method.gg calls it underwhelming solo but strong in groups.
Warcraft Tavern Classic says train only rank 1 of Thunder Clap, Cleave, Overpower and Shield Bash, but its own level list later buys Overpower ranks 2-3.
Warcraft Tavern Classic says skip Mocking Blow but also lists it at level 16.
Rend: Classic guides did not prioritise Rend ranks; Forever gives Rend significant AP scaling (Blizzard, Method.gg), so ranks are recommended here.
forever_differences: Tactical Mastery (keep 10 rage) is baseline at 14; the talent became Improved Tactical Mastery (Blizzard deep dive).
Victory Rush is new baseline at 20: instant, 30 s cooldown, heals 10% max health after a kill (Blizzard deep dive).
Rend and Thunder Clap gained significant AP scaling; Thunder Clap usable in Defensive Stance with 6 s cooldown (Blizzard deep dive).
Retaliation, Shield Wall and Recklessness no longer share cooldowns; Retaliation/Shield Wall cooldown 15 min (Blizzard deep dive).
Battle Shout AP reduced but includes Improved Battle Shout; Improved Demoralizing Shout baseline (Blizzard deep dive).
Sunder Armor threat scales with AP (Blizzard deep dive); rank 1 comes from the Defensive Stance quest (Method.gg).
Rage from damage dealt is based on weapon speed; crits give 75% more rage (Blizzard deep dive).
Bloodthirst no longer heals, grants 10% move speed instead (Blizzard deep dive).
Slam rank 1 at 20 uses a new spell ID; Improved Slam (Arms) makes Slam not reset swing timer (Blizzard deep dive).
open_questions: Intercept rank 1 is not on the trainer list (ranks 2-3 are); presumably granted by the Berserker Stance quest at 30.
Defensive Stance, Berserker Stance, Taunt and Sunder Armor rank 1 are not on the trainer list; quest-granted per Method.gg.
No Forever guide read gives rank-by-rank skip advice; rank skips follow Classic guidance.
